**Map size: grow or crop the map by tiles.** Edit ▸ Map Size… adds tiles of 128 blocks to any side of the map or takes them away, and a click or a drag on the map's picture adds or removes tiles one by one, as WorldPainter's Add/Remove Tiles. The land added continues the map's edges (their heights, water, terrains and biomes, smoothed farther out), or slopes into a sea, eases to flat land, or into generated hills, over as many blocks as you choose, so the map ends in no cliff. One step to undo.
